summary: The Real Brokerage Inc. (Real) reported voting results from its August 14, 2026 special meeting, where securityholders approved Real's proposed acquisition of RE/MAX Holdings, Inc. Shareholders holding 62.29% of common shares were present; 99.01% of votes cast favored the arrangement, exceeding the required two-thirds majority. Optionholders and RSU holders also approved. The combined company will operate as Real REMAX Group. The filing notes RE/MAX securityholders also approved. No deal terms are specified beyond the arrangement. What to watch: regulatory approvals and closing conditions; risk-arb focuses on deal timing and potential regulatory hurdles.
